fieldValues.title: Writing domain: one writer, evidence-backed, muDemocracy first
fieldValues.decision_question: What is the Collaborative writing domain, and for whom?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's local planning session on 2026-10-11 (srs-programme#89); awaiting the owner's ratification in a clerk session.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: A new domain beside Collaborative writing; keeping several authors in scope.
fieldValues.decision_statement: The Collaborative writing domain is rewritten in place as Evidence-backed writing: one writer building a carefully structured, evidence-based text that withstands critical argument; agents respond (link claims, problems, quotes; red team; blue team) and never write. Start from the owner's muDemocracy case and generalise over time. Problems are thrown in as a brainstorm and refined and synthesised later as an ongoing understanding process. SP-20 and SP-21 (save and reintegrate) stay and will also belong to a separate technical domain.
